title: Arrived cracked
text: Arrived cracked. Frames arrived shrink wrapped together but not in cardboard. The shipping box they arrived in was not damaged, but as you can see in the picture the plexiglass was cracked in one of the frames. The frames are great but I am unsure if I will order anymore if I have to worry about any being broken upon arrival.
